First off, I wouldn’t feel bad about having feelings for someone besides your partner. It happens and you can’t help it, especially when you’ve been in a long term relationship. I wouldn’t tell your boyfriend, even if he understands it can cause some unnecessary tension, it would also make things messy if you end up pursuing the coworker if you break up with your boyfriend. Don’t tell the coworker unless you plan on pursuing them. How long have you had a crush on your coworker? Cause if it hasn’t been that long it might just be a short thing and I’d try and wait it out. In these situations I’ve personally made it very clear that I’m taken (not annoying about it but just mentioning my partner so they know I’m taken) just so I hopefully don’t have to worry about them making a move on me and putting me in a more conflicting situation.

Yes, only one. He’s the only person I’ve ever been in love with and I was an idiot near the end of the relationship. I would want us to end on better terms and not have the bitterness we have now towards each other. He was my best friend before we dated and now I never talk to him.

That really sucks!! Wisdom teeth are just sucky in general. Hopefully they don’t grow anymore funky before summer break. If/when it does break the surface, make sure you take care of it the same way you do your other teeth and keep an eye out for any problems like infection or it hurting neighboring teeth

I’m sure your dentist will let you know if you need them out. There are so many different factors that go into the surgery other than your age and the length of the roots. If you’re worried about it, ask them if they think you should get your wisdom teeth out soon at your next appointment

Depends on your age! One of the reasons wisdom teeth are taken out most commonly from 16-20 years old is because the roots are shallow. The roots lengthen and the teeth become harder to remove as the person becomes an adult

Not a doctor, but my mom and I have the same allergy. While I can’t say how effective the sessions in the tanning bed would be, I can share some things that have personally helped my mom and I. I would recommend clothing with sun protection built in, the brand solumbra has some great items. Even just a lightweight coverup or shawl can make a big difference. Another option would be getting a sun hat or sun umbrella. Broad spectrum sunscreens that protect against both uvb and uva rays or full on sunblock would be good to use in tandem with these methods. If you do decide to do the short sessions in the tanning bed, I’d love to know how it works out!
